summary: kubernetes.core removed the deprecated k8s inventory plugin and support for ansible-core < 2.16.
questions: Is the kubernetes.core k8s inventory plugin still available?

answer_card.title: kubernetes.core removed k8s inventory
answer_card.answer_md: kubernetes.core (Ansible 12.0.0) **removed the deprecated `k8s` inventory plugin** and dropped support for ansible-core **< 2.16**.
